name: Ranger Silent, But Deadly: direct Physical damage can unlock Deadshot above 20% health (#1209)
contract: Silent, But Deadly 524873 reads 'Direct Physical damage dealt now has an $h% chance to allow you to use Deadshot regardless of the targets health for $524872d.' ($h = ProcChance 8, $524872d = DurationIndex 31 = 8 sec). Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on 524872, a self aura SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_IGNORE_AURASTATE (262) with SpellFamilyName 27 and EffectSpellClassMask (1048576,0,0), which is Deadshot's own SpellFamilyFlags (520227 and ranks). Deadshot's 'Only usable on enemies below 20% health' is TargetAuraState 2; Unit::HasAuraState returns true when the caster holds an ABILITY_IGNORE_AURASTATE aura affecting the spell. Spell.dbc gives 524873 ProcFlags 0; the spell_proc row from rev_20260921_40_ranger_dead_procs.sql (ProcFlags 340 = melee/ranged white hits and melee/ranged abilities, SchoolMask 1, phase HIT) is what lets it fire. Expected: at full target health Deadshot is refused with SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_AURASTATE (111); after the talent is learned, white melee hits eventually grant 524872 (8% per hit: about 126 swings fit in 240 sec, so a false failure has probability near 3e-5), and while it is up Deadshot lands on the same full-health enemy.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Deadshot target is at full health
Control Deadshot on a full-health enemy
Control: Deadshot does not land on an enemy above 20% health
Control: Deadshot is refused for the target's health state
SETUP: Silent, But Deadly is active on the Ranger
White melee hits deal direct Physical damage
Direct Physical damage eventually grants Silent, But Deadly
The buff came from the talent's proc
Deadshot on the same full-health enemy while the buff is up
Deadshot lands regardless of the target's health
